question_text: When will Trump's nominee for BLS Commissioner be confirmed?
resolution_criteria:
If EJ Antoni is the first person confirmed by the Senate to be BLS Commissioner before Jan 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
If EJ Antoni has a nomination that's withdrawn, then the market immediately resolves to No.
